## Solo Developer Notes

**Response Time**: 1-3 business days (depending on availability and priority)

**What Helps Me Fix This Faster**:
- Clear steps to reproduce
- Complete environment information
- Relevant logs and error messages
- Screenshots for UI issues
- Database context if data-related

**What I Can't Help With**:
- Issues in heavily customized deployments
- Problems with custom integrations
- Issues in deprecated versions

Thank you for taking the time to report this bug! 🐛
